When you launch the dev client yourself to screenshot or drive it, skip the onboarding sheet, the dev menu at launch, and the Tools button. On SDK 58+, Expo CLI does this for launches it starts from a non-interactive shell; for a URL you open yourself, use `<scheme>://?__expo_url=<encoded dev server URL>&__expo_disable_onboarding=1&__expo_disable_fab=1&__expo_disable_auto_launch=1`. On SDK 57 and earlier, launch the iOS app with the `-EXDevMenu*` launch arguments, and on Android open `<scheme>://expo-development-client/?url=<encoded dev server URL>&disableOnboarding=1&disableFab=1&disableAutoLaunch=1`. See [reviewed upstream launch guide](https://github.com/expo/skills/blob/7ddc1f5796996e5c7efe2fc3fa9168eb24e8dac1/plugins/expo/skills/expo-overview/references/launch-without-dev-menu.md) for the exact commands.
